title: THE LONG WAY BACK · XVI · The lighthouse
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop sixteen: a lighthouse on a headland in a storm, its lamp out, a crack the traveler swears runs from the lantern room to the base, and two gulls falling past it with the wind. The card: a tower struck. The traveler draws the crack and then, in the third tier, draws it not there. He can't decide. He keeps both.
